messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — EdgeWave sent their final usage-reporting contract. They expect minutely usage granularity, per-device IDs, and a signed webhook for each batch. Go-live target is Friday so we need to confirm approach today.

Jason Park: Do we have capacity to ingest minutely from partners? Our current marketplace pipeline only stores hourly rollups.

Priya Rao: Short answer: yes, but with limits. Proposal: 2-phase launch. Phase 1 (go-live): accept minutely batches into a raw ingestion topic (best-effort), continue to publish our hourly rollups to billing. Phase 2 (30d): enable full minutely aggregation pipeline and reconciliation so partner claims can be matched to raw events.

Maria Chen: Sounds reasonable. EdgeWave is pushing for immediate near-real-time credits if usage spikes. How do we protect against duplicates / replay?

Jason Park: Require event_id + sequence_number and an idempotency window on our side. Also verify signature header. Our standard is HMAC-SHA256 with timestamp and 5m skew. Example verification: `signature = HMAC_SHA256(shared_key, timestamp + '.' + body)`; compare to X-EdgeWave-Sig.

integration-bot: sample webhook payload: `{"tenant_id":"edgewave-234","device_id":"EW-abc-123","interval_start":"2026-03-20T12:03:00Z","interval_secs":60,"usage_units":12.5,"event_id":"evt_01F..."}`

Priya Rao: For late arrivals we should define an SLA window. Proposal: 24h accepted for credits, 7d visibility for analytics only, and any >7d goes to manual review. Also, we should publish a reconciliation job that runs daily and flags >0.5% delta at tenant level.

Jason Park: +1. Also need to map device SKUs to our plan SKUs — suggest a mapping table maintained by Partnerships (CSV) and a canonical lookup API. Backfill plan: replay 48h of raw events into new pipeline for initial equalization.

Maria Chen: Action items: 1) Priya to own the SLA and reconciliation thresholds doc; 2) Jason to prepare verification snippet + idempotency middleware; 3) Partnerships (me) to schedule call with EdgeWave in next 2 business hours and share mapping template. I'll ping EdgeWave now. :eyes:

Priya Rao: I'll add the reconciliation runbook to the repo and include test cases for duplicate/corrupt payloads.

Jason Park: I'll open a small RFC with the sample HMAC code and middleware. Will also add metrics: per-tenant delta %, late-arrival rate, duplicate suppression rate.

Maria Chen: Great. If anyone sees blockers post-call, drop them here. :thumbsup:
